description: Real Blackjack — hit, stand, double down, dealer hits to 17, blackjack pays 3:2, with a session bankroll.

faqs.a: Hit (take a card), Stand (keep your hand), or Double (double the bet, take exactly one card).
The dealer reveals the hidden card, then hits until reaching 17 or more.
Blackjack (Ace + 10-value) pays 3:2. A tie with the dealer is a push — your bet is returned.
You start with 1,000 credits. It persists while you play; if you go broke it resets to 1,000.

howto: Choose your bet and press Deal.
Beat the dealer without going over 21.
title: Blackjack Game
